alternative_names: theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bka' gnad kyi mtha' dpyad mun sel (cover page)
name: theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i dka' gnad kyi mtha' dpyad mun sel
item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs.
25 folios numbered from 1 to 24, with a "2 'og ma" and a "3 gong ma" between fol. 2 and fol. 3.
On the cover page, dbu can letter "ma" on the right of the signature.
